entry.title: Learning Dexterous Manipulation with Diffusion Policies
entry.summary: We propose a robotics method for embodied manipulation using diffusion models and a humanoid with two arms.

entry.title: Vision-Language Models Improve Robot Navigation
entry.summary: A large multimodal model boosts embodied AI perception for autonomous drones and quadruped robots.

entry.title: Efficient Pretraining of a 7B Language Model
entry.summary: We study training and alignment of an open-source LLM with reduced compute via better transformer design.
